svg.title: Madagascar interlock network
svg.text: 25 firms in 10 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 175 firms, 493 interlocks, 11 components (largest 150). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 54 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
